import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

checker=Path('scripts/check-doc-links.py').resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('doc_links',checker)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
def snapshot():
    sources=list(module.sources())
    content={str(p.relative_to(Path.cwd())): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sources}
    for p in [checker,Path('Taskfile.yml'),Path(__file__)]:
        content[str(p)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    targets={}
    for p in sources:
        for href in module.links(p):
            resolved=module.resolve(p,href)
            if resolved is None: continue
            dest,anchor=resolved
            targets[str(dest)]={'exists':dest.exists()}
            if anchor and dest.suffix=='.md' and dest.exists():
                content[str(dest)]=hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return {'content':content,'targets':targets}
command=['mise','exec','--','task','check:docs']
before=snapshot()
result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
after=snapshot()
base=Path('docs/verification/settings-activation/ordering-capture-evidence/docs-complete')
base.with_suffix('.txt').write_bytes(result.stdout)
base.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':command,'status':result.returncode,'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),'before':before,'after':after,'subjects_unchanged':before==after,'instrument_source':Path(__file__).read_text()},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':result.returncode,'subjects_unchanged':before==after,'content_subjects':len(before['content'])}))
print(result.stdout.decode())
